plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU) to eliminate that risk.
Sell remaining AI/Software leveraged plays (METU, MSFU, PLTU) to reduce overall leverage.
Trim QQQI to 20% to reduce concentration and increase cash buffer.
Hold SPY and QQQ for broad market exposure.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation with a significant cash buffer.
Expect lower volatility and a more conservative return profile.
conservative.read: This plan aims for capital preservation with a target of ~1.5% monthly return. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration, increasing the cash buffer. Drawdowns should be minimal, but upside potential is also capped.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU) to a small allocation.
Trim AI/Software leveraged positions (METU, MSFU, PLTU) to reduce overall leverage.
Trim QQQI to 25% to manage concentration while retaining income exposure.
Buy OXY, a top-rated scanner setup, to add a new, strong position.
Maintain a balanced mix of broad index, income, and quality tech.
This plan balances growth with risk management, aiming for steady progress.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets ~2.5% monthly return by managing risk first. It trims leverage and concentration while adding a high-quality new name. Expect moderate growth with controlled drawdowns.

plan: Increase exposure to leveraged AI/Software (METU, MSFU, PLTU) and Semiconductor (SOXL, MUU) ETFs.
Add SPAL to further leverage the semiconductor sector.
Trim QQQI to 25% to manage concentration while retaining some income.
Buy OXY, a top-rated scanner setup, to add a new, strong position.
This plan concentrates risk in high-conviction, leveraged areas.
Expect higher potential returns but also significantly larger drawdowns and leverage decay.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% monthly return by leaning into leverage and concentration. It increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and high-growth sectors. Be aware of amplified drawdowns and the daily rebalancing decay of leveraged ETFs.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, MUU, SPAL) and AI/Software leveraged plays (METU, MSFU, PLTU) to cut risk.
Increase QQQI to 30% to maximize income-generating asset allocation.
Hold SPY and QQQ for broad market exposure and potential monthly distributions.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly income over aggressive growth.
It aims for low drawdowns and reliable, though variable, income distributions.
Expect modest growth, with the primary goal being yield generation.
income.read: This income-focused plan targets ~1% monthly return through distributions. It eliminates leverage and high-beta single names, concentrating on income-generating ETFs like QQQI. While aiming for low drawdowns, NAV can still fall in market downturns.
